name: China Dongxiang (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: China Dongxiang (Group) Co., Ltd., established in 2002 and headquartered in Beijing, designs, develops, markets and sells sports apparel, footwear and accessories in China and abroad under brands such as Kappa and Phenix, through stores, outlets and online platforms. It also invests in bank-issued financial products, sells children's clothing, and has hotel management, tourism and real estate businesses.
